node.label: rhizomelic chondrodysplasia punctata
node.definition: Rhizomelic chondrodysplasia is a form chondrodysplasia punctata, a group of diseases in which the common characteristic is calcifications near joints at birth.

children_labels.MONDO:0100265: peroxisome biogenesis disorder due to PEX5 defect in the PEX7-binding domain
